# Founder Board

Your board of directors for a new business idea. The skill writes founder/idea.md from the conversation, briefs three sub-agents, and has each one read the idea through one published framework only: the Offers lens (from $100M Offers by Alex Hormozi), the Monopoly lens (from Zero to One by Peter Thiel with Blake Masters) and the Product lens (from the Steve Jobs biography by Walter Isaacson). Each member scores the idea from 1 to 10, lists the top three risks that would kill it, asks its questions and votes fund, fund with conditions, or pass. The chair then merges the three memos into founder/board.md with the vote, the shared risks first, every condition as a checklist for the rest of the founder pack, and the strongest version of the business the board can see. The board members are not those people and never speak as them: they apply published frameworks only. First step of the founder pack, and it also runs on its own.
